text.description_html:
Laurey 74666, Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Small Oil Rubbed Bronze Aventura Cabinet Pull is made out of zinc. This cabinet handle is a great choice for any home remodel project. The Oil Rubbed Bronze finish is stunning. The Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74666 96mm Pull Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
